commands.name: native-row-value-rule
commands.run: python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; s=u.spec_from_file_location('c','claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py'); c=u.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(c); row=dict(launch_id='L1',phase='implement',runtime='claude',workspace_id='w1',pane_id='p1',source_head_sha='a'*40); assert c._native_worker_row(row); assert not c._native_worker_row({**row,'runtime':'other'}); assert not c._native_worker_row({**row,'source_head_sha':'a'*39}); assert not c._native_worker_row({**row,'source_head_sha':'A'*40}); assert not c._native_worker_row({**row,'workspace_id':'w 1'}); assert not c._native_worker_row({**row,'pane_id':'<unreadable>'}); assert c.UNREADABLE_SENTINEL=='<unreadable>'"

commands.name: reader-size-cap-parity
commands.run: python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; s=u.spec_from_file_location('c','claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py'); c=u.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(c); assert c.TASK_RECORD_MAX_BYTES==2_000_000; src=open('claude/hooks/herdr_dispatch.py').read(); assert '2_000_000' in src.split('def _read_task')[0].split('def _read_json')[1]"

commands.name: dead-inherited-refusal-removed
commands.run: if grep -q 'inherited task workers' claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py; then exit 1; fi

commands.name: regression-checks-present
commands.run: grep -qF 'write-task bound path refuses invalid identity values per field' claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh && grep -qF 'write-task and outstanding_descendants catch decoder recursion' claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh && grep -qF 'task record writers refuse a record over the dispatch reader limit' claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh && grep -qF 'unbound explicit workers list may not shrink dispatch history' claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh && grep -qF 'reset-task opens a fresh task id and retains the old record' claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh
